quote.text: Men do not care how nobly they live, but only how long, although it is within the reach of every man to live nobly, but within no man's power to live long. Farewell.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • In parenting, focus on cultivating virtue and integrity in your children rather than merely ensuring longevity; the true legacy lies in the nobility of character you help foster.
    • Remember that each moment spent teaching and guiding with wisdom enriches lives far beyond the constraints of time—nurture hearts, not just habits.
  • Leadership
    • As a leader, measure your success not by the duration of your tenure but by the impact of your noble deeds and the integrity you model for others.
    • Embrace the transient nature of life as a call to act with urgency: let your leadership be defined by courage, ethical principles, and transformative actions.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, the pursuit should be about creating meaningful, high-quality solutions that reflect enduring values rather than solely chasing long-term market presence.
    • Prioritize noble intent in innovation—design products that enrich lives and contribute to the common good, for true success lies in the impact of your endeavors, not merely in their longevity.
